saints.name: The Most Holy Name of Mary
saints.title: Memorial of Our Lady's Name
saints.shortBlurb: A day set apart to honour the name of the Virgin Mother, extended to the whole Church in thanksgiving for the deliverance of Vienna…
biography: The feast of the Holy Name of Mary, long kept in Spain, was extended to the universal Church by Pope Innocent XI in gratitude for the victory that lifted the Turkish siege of Vienna on 12 September 1683. As the feast of the Holy Name of Jesus honours the name at which every knee should bow, so this memorial honours the name of his Mother.
The day invites the faithful to venerate Mary under her own name and to invoke her intercession, mindful of her place in the mystery of salvation as Mother of the Redeemer.
saints.knownFor: Honouring the name of the Mother of God.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), "The Holy Name of Mary"
